FORM / SIGNAL

Build your signal.

Choose a sample or import a 3D model. Switch between ASCII characters, pixel blocks and tracked regions of light.

  1. Select a node in the network to open its parameters. Drag its header to arrange the workspace. Connections keep their fixed processing order.
  2. Uncheck an effect node to bypass it. Drag the object to orbit, and scroll or pinch to zoom.
  3. Open perlin1 to adjust noise intensity, scale, motion, and blending. Pause the viewer to stop motion.
  4. Pick a finish, add your own poster lettering, then export the current frame as a PNG.

Models stay in your browser. GLB works best; GLTF files must contain their resources. Blob tracking detects bright regions in the rendered object, drawing boxes and persistent IDs as it moves.
